name: Shadcn Dashboard
summary: Free and paid shadcn dashboard kit with 200+ blocks and 400+ components, admin templates and AI prompts for React and Next.js.
description: A shadcn-format registry of dashboard UI for React, Next.js and Base UI: 204+ blocks — dashboard shell, datatable, chart, card, chat and notes applications — and 400+ components styled with Tailwind CSS and TypeScript, plus a Next.js admin template, a TanStack Start template and a Supabase boilerplate. Items install with the shadcn CLI or by copy-paste, with an MCP server and AI Dashboard Builder wired to pre-built prompts; a free tier plus one-time Pro, Teams and Enterprise licenses.
